claims.text: The source scales VQ-VAE with two-level discrete maps (256px: 32x32 top + 64x64 bottom conditioned on top; FFHQ-1024 adds 128x128), EMA codebooks, feed-forward decoder, and PixelSnail priors; single feed-forward decode runs ~30x faster than pixel-space.

Reported numbers: ImageNet-256 NLL top 3.40/3.41 + bottom 3.45/3.45 (train/val); CAS Top-1/Top-5 54.83/77.59 (58.74/80.98 after reconstruction) vs BigGAN-deep 42.65/65.92 vs real 73.09/91.47; FID ~30 to ~10 with classifier rejection at diversity cost.

limitations.text: Latent-space likelihood not comparable across encoders; FID/IS sensitive to VQ blur; prior training 1.6M/754k steps heavy.
